_comment: Single source for every outbound link and the price string. Nothing else in the repo may hardcode these — scripts/build-workflows.mjs injects them, and scripts/validate.mjs fails the build if a hardcoded Apify URL or price appears anywhere else.
_affiliate: Empty on purpose — the owner has not registered for the Apify Affiliate Program yet.
_price: Pricing is pay-per-event: from $0.70 per 1,000 ads ($0.0012 on Free down to $0.0007 on Gold) plus $0.01 per competitor checked in monitor mode.
